daily_load_assessment: The athlete is in a favorable recovery position today with a positive Form (TSB) of +3.4. The last two days involved a rest day (August 26) and a low-intensity 5km run (August 27, 24 load). Combined with no negative subjective feedback or Garmin warnings, the athlete is physically and neuromuscularly primed to absorb a high-stress quality session.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the current 21-day block, the athlete has maintained exceptional consistency with 15 sessions over 14 hours. ATL (35.5) has fallen slightly below CTL (38.9), showing that fatigue is well-managed. To continue driving the CTL upward toward the goal of 60, we need to carefully inject targeted quality work while leveraging the massive aerobic engine built via daily commutes.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Long-term progression is highly stable but currently plateauing around a CTL of ~39. To reach the seasonal milestone of 60 CTL safely (+1 to +2 per week), we must transition from pure volume maintenance into a strict pyramidal pattern. 70% base is solid; the remaining 30% must focus on hitting 5-minute cycling power and 5km running pace goals.
coach_verdict: Take advantage of the positive TSB (+3.4) and recent recovery runway. Today is an absolute green light for Priority 1: High-Intensity VO2max Cycling Intervals. This session will aggressively target your 5-minute VO2max power goal, forcing cardiovascular adaptation while your legs are exceptionally fresh.

priority_1.workout_details: Warm-up: 15 mins ramping to Zone 2 with 3x30s high-cadence spin-ups. Main set: 5 x 4 minutes at 115-120% FTP (295W - 310W) with 4 minutes easy recovery between intervals. Cool-down: 10 mins Zone 1.
priority_1.reason: Highest recommendation. Your positive TSB and recent low-load days make this the perfect window to hit a true high-intensity interval session to force the cardiac remodeling needed for your 5-minute power goals.

priority_2.session_title: Aerobic Base Zone 2 Run + Neuromuscular Strides
priority_2.workout_details: Warm-up: 5 mins dynamic joint mobility. Main set: 45 minutes flat, steady run strictly in HR Zone 2 (135-150 bpm). Finish with 5 x 15-second progressive strides at 5km target pace with full recovery walk back. Cool-down: 5 mins walking.
priority_2.reason: Second recommendation. If you prefer to run today or feel slight local muscular tightness, this low-intensity base builder reinforces the 70% aerobic engine rule while the strides keep your neuromuscular pathway sharp for 5km pacing.

priority_3.workout_details: 1. Barbell Back Squat: 4 sets x 6 reps (RPE 8). 2. Overhead Press: 3 sets x 8 reps. 3. Heavy Sandbag Clean & Carry (70kg): 3 sets of 50 meters. 4. Core: Hanging Leg Raises 3 x max. 5. Finisher: Barbell Bicep Curls 3 x 10.
priority_3.reason: Third recommendation. Provides a premium strength stimulus focusing on building high-torque power for cycling climbs and upper body aesthetic goals without adding cardiovascular fatigue.
